observation.visible_scene: A night view across a calm water surface decorated with illuminated displays: a glowing pale-yellow crescent-moon sculpture on the left, several small cyan star-shaped lights, a carriage-like structure with two large fixed circular wheels in the center, a glowing cyan spherical lamp on the right, and a long horizontal railing/bridge strung with a programmable LED strip. The lights and sculptures cast colorful, broken reflections on the rippling water below.
visible_changes: The LED strip along the railing cycles through color programs over the excerpt: blue/purple with orange-red points (frames 1-10), then a multicolor rainbow pattern (frames 11-23), then pink/magenta mixed with green (frames 24-35), then returning to blue/purple with orange-red points (frames 36-41).
The water reflections mirror these strip-color changes, shifting from blue/orange to rainbow to pink/green and back.
The water surface continuously ripples, so the reflections shimmer, stretch into dashes, and wobble slightly in position frame to frame.

The crescent moon, the star lights, the spherical lamp, and the two-wheel structure stay fixed in screen position and keep constant colors (moon yellow, stars and sphere cyan) throughout; the wheels show no rotation.
The camera framing of all structures is unchanged across frames, indicating no significant camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: The complete color sequence/program of the LED strip and what triggered the changes (no controller or person is visible).
Whether the wheels ever rotate outside this segment.
The state of the scene before t=0 and after t=1.33 s.
uncertain_details: Exact frame boundaries of each color-mode transition.
Whether the water motion is wind, current, or footstep disturbance (cause not visible).
Any sub-pixel camera drift is not reliably detectable given the static background.
